img, svg { display: block; max-width: 100%; }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
a { color: var(--c-accent); }

[hidden] { display: none !important; }

/* 焦点环：所有主题、所有底色上都清晰可见 */
:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--c-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
  border-radius: 4px;
}

.sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px; height: 1px;
  padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

.skip-link {
  position: absolute;
  left: 16px;
  top: -100px;
  z-index: 100;
  padding: 12px 18px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  color: var(--c-text);
  border: 2px solid var(--c-accent);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: top .15s ease;
}
.skip-link:focus { top: 12px; }

.wrap {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--wrap);
  margin-inline: auto;
  padding-inline: 20px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   3. 按钮
   ========================================================================== */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  min-height: 48px;              /* 触控目标 ≥44px */
  padding: 10px 22px;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  border-radius: 999px;
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.3;
  text-align: center;
  text-decoration: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease,
              color .16s ease, transform .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease;
}
.btn svg { flex: 0 0 auto; }

.btn-primary {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: var(--c-accent-ink);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
}
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--c-accent-hover); }
.btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

.btn-ghost {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  color: var(--c-text);
  border-color: var(--c-border-strong);
}
.btn-ghost:hover { background: var(--c-surface-2); border-color: var(--c-accent); }

.btn-block { width: 100%; }
.btn-sm { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 15px; }

/* ==========================================================================
   4. 页头 / 导航
   ========================================================================== */
.site-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 50;
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--c-bg) 88%, transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}
@supports not (backdrop-filter: blur(1px)) {
  .site-header { background: var(--c-bg); }
}

.header-inner {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 16px;
  min-height: var(--header-h);
  padding-block: 8px;
}

.brand {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 9px;
  min-height: 44px;
  margin-right: auto;
  color: var(--c-text);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .01em;
}
.brand-mark { flex: 0 0 auto; }
.brand-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.1; font-size: 17px; }
.brand-sub {
  font-size: 10px;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: .14em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--c-text-faint);
}

.nav-list { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.nav-list a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 0 14px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
  transition: background-color .16s ease, color .16s ease;
}
.nav-list a:hover { background: var(--c-surface-2); color: var(--c-text); }

.header-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }

/* 主题切换：原生 radio，方向键即可在组内切换 */
.theme-switch {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2px;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 2px;
  min-width: 0;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--c-surface-2);
}
.theme-switch input {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px; height: 1px;
  padding: 0; margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
  clip-path: inset(50%);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}
.theme-switch label {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;                  /* 触控目标 44×44 */
  border-radius: 999px;
  color: var(--c-text-faint);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background-color .16s ease, color .16s ease;
}
.theme-switch label:hover { color: var(--c-text); }
.theme-switch input:checked + label {
  background: var(--c-surface);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
}
.theme-switch input:focus-visible + label {
  outline: 3px solid var(--c-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

/* ==========================================================================
   5. 区块骨架
   ========================================================================== */
.section {
  padding-block: clamp(56px, 9vw, 100px);
  scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--header-h) + 12px);
}
.section + .section { border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border); }

.section-head { max-width: 620px; margin-bottom: clamp(32px, 5vw, 52px); }

.eyebrow {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 14px;
  padding: 6px 14px 6px 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-accent-line);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--c-accent-soft);
  color: var(--c-accent);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .02em;
}

h1 {
  font-size: clamp(34px, 6.4vw, 58px);
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -.02em;
  font-weight: 800;
}
h2 {
  font-size: clamp(26px, 4vw, 38px);
  line-height: 1.22;
  letter-spacing: -.015em;
  font-weight: 800;
}
h3 { font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.35; font-weight: 700; }

.section-lead, .lead {
  margin-top: 16px;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: clamp(16px, 1.4vw, 18px);
  line-height: 1.6;
}

.hl { color: var(--c-accent); }

/* ==========================================================================
   6. Hero
   ========================================================================== */
.hero { padding-block: clamp(40px, 7vw, 84px) clamp(56px, 9vw, 100px); }
.hero-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: clamp(36px, 6vw, 60px);
  align-items: center;
}
.hero-cta {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px;
  margin-top: 28px;
}
.hero-stats {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 14px 32px;
  margin-top: 36px;
  padding-top: 26px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
}
.hero-stats li { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.hero-stats strong { font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: -.01em; }
.hero-stats span { color: var(--c-text-faint); font-size: 14px; }

.hero-visual { position: relative; }
.map-frame {
  position: relative;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
  overflow: hidden;
}
.map { width: 100%; height: auto; }

.chip {
  position: absolute;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 7px;
  max-width: 62%;
  padding: 8px 13px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--c-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
  white-space: nowrap;
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
}
.chip--warn {
  top: 14px; right: 14px;
  border-color: var(--c-warn-bright);
  background: var(--c-warn-soft);
  color: var(--c-warn);
}
.chip--lit {
  bottom: 14px; left: 14px;
  border-color: var(--c-accent-line);
  background: var(--c-accent-soft);
  color: var(--c-accent);
}
.chip svg { flex: 0 0 auto; }

/* 路线动效：彗星沿路径行进 —— 靠 pathLength 归一化，永远贴着路线 */
.route-comet { stroke-dasharray: 16 984; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {
  .route-comet { animation: route-travel 5.5s linear infinite; }
  .hazard-pulse { animation: hazard-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
}
@keyframes route-travel {
  from { stroke-dashoffset: 1000; }
  to   { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
}
@keyframes hazard-pulse {
  0%, 100% { opacity: .18; transform: scale(1); }
  50%      { opacity: .40; transform: scale(1.5); }
}
.hazard-pulse { transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }

/* ==========================================================================
   7. 功能卡
   ========================================================================== */
.cards {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
}
.card {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 28px 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
  transition: border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease;
}
.card:hover { border-color: var(--c-accent-line); transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-2); }

.card-icon {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 52px; height: 52px;
  margin-bottom: 20px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  background: var(--c-accent-soft);
  color: var(--c-accent);
}
.card-icon--warn { background: var(--c-warn-soft); color: var(--c-warn); }

.card p { margin-top: 10px; color: var(--c-text-muted); }

.card-list { margin-top: 18px; display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.card-list li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 9px;
  font-size: 15px;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
}
.card-list svg { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--c-accent); }

/* ==========================================================================
   8. 定价
   ========================================================================== */
.plans {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 20px;
  align-items: start;
}
.plan {
  position: relative;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  padding: 30px 24px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--c-surface);
}
.plan--featured {
  border: 2px solid var(--c-accent);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-2);
}
.plan-badge {
  position: absolute;
  top: -13px; left: 24px;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 6px;
  padding: 4px 12px;
  border-radius: 999px;
  background: var(--c-accent);
  color: var(--c-accent-ink);
  font-size: 12px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}
.plan-name { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--c-text-muted); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.plan-price { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; margin-top: 10px; }
.plan-price .amount { font-size: 42px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -.03em; line-height: 1; }
.plan-price .per { color: var(--c-text-faint); font-size: 14px; }
.plan-desc { margin-top: 12px; color: var(--c-text-muted); font-size: 15px; }

.plan-features { margin-top: 22px; padding-top: 20px; border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border); display: grid; gap: 2px; }
.plan-features li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  padding: 9px 0;
  font-size: 15px;
  min-height: 40px;
}
.plan-features svg { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: 2px; }
.plan-features .yes { color: var(--c-text); }
.plan-features .yes svg { color: var(--c-success); }
.plan-features .no { color: var(--c-text-faint); }
.plan-features .no svg { color: var(--c-text-faint); }

.plan .btn { margin-top: 22px; }
.plans-note {
  margin-top: 26px;
  color: var(--c-text-faint);
  font-size: 14px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
}
.plans-note svg { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: 1px; }

/* ==========================================================================
   9. 订阅表单
   ========================================================================== */
.subscribe-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: clamp(32px, 5vw, 56px);
  align-items: start;
}
.subscribe-points { margin-top: 24px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.subscribe-points li {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  font-size: 15px;
}
.subscribe-points svg { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: 3px; color: var(--c-accent); }

.subscribe-form {
  padding: clamp(22px, 3vw, 32px);
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-1);
}
.form-title { font-size: 19px; font-weight: 700; }
.form-sub { margin-top: 6px; color: var(--c-text-muted); font-size: 15px; }

.field { margin-top: 22px; }
.field-label {
  display: block;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.req { color: var(--c-danger); }

.field-hint { margin-top: 8px; color: var(--c-text-faint); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; }

.field-control { position: relative; }
.field-icon {
  position: absolute;
  left: 14px; top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--c-text-faint);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.input, .select {
  width: 100%;
  min-height: 48px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-border-strong);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--c-bg);
  color: var(--c-text);
  transition: border-color .16s ease, box-shadow .16s ease;
}
.input::placeholder { color: var(--c-text-faint); opacity: 1; }
.input--icon { padding-left: 44px; }
.input:hover, .select:hover { border-color: var(--c-accent); }

.select {
  appearance: none;
  -webkit-appearance: none;
  padding-right: 44px;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.select-chevron {
  position: absolute;
  right: 14px; top: 50%;
  transform: translateY(-50%);
  color: var(--c-text-faint);
  pointer-events: none;
}

/* 错误态 */
.field.has-error .input,
.field.has-error .select { border-color: var(--c-danger); border-width: 2px; }
.field.has-error .input-icon,
.field.has-error .field-icon { color: var(--c-danger); }

.field-error {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 8px;
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding: 9px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--c-danger-soft);
  color: var(--c-danger);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.45;
}
.field-error svg { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: 2px; }

/* 复选框 */
.field-check { margin-top: 22px; }
.check {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 12px;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: 10px 0;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.check-box {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  width: 24px; height: 24px;
  margin-top: 1px;
  border: 2px solid var(--c-border-strong);
  border-radius: 7px;
  background: var(--c-bg);
  color: transparent;
  transition: background-color .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, color .16s ease;
}
.check:hover .check-box { border-color: var(--c-accent); }
.check input:checked + .check-box {
  background: var(--c-accent);
  border-color: var(--c-accent);
  color: var(--c-accent-ink);
}
.check input:focus-visible + .check-box {
  outline: 3px solid var(--c-focus);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.check-text { font-size: 15px; color: var(--c-text-muted); line-height: 1.5; }
.field.has-error .check-box { border-color: var(--c-danger); }

.form-actions { margin-top: 26px; }
.form-status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 9px;
  margin-top: 18px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--c-success);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  background: var(--c-success-soft);
  color: var(--c-success);
  font-size: 15px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.form-status svg { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: 2px; }

/* ==========================================================================
   10. 页脚
   ========================================================================== */
.site-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  background: var(--c-surface);
  padding-block: clamp(44px, 6vw, 64px) 32px;
}
.footer-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  gap: 32px;
}
.footer-brand .brand { margin-right: 0; }
.footer-tag { margin-top: 14px; max-width: 34ch; color: var(--c-text-muted); font-size: 15px; }

.footer-col h4 {
  margin: 0 0 6px;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--c-text-faint);
}
.footer-col li a {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 44px;              /* 触控目标 ≥44px */
  color: var(--c-text-muted);
  text-decoration: none;
  font-size: 15px;
}
.footer-col li a:hover { color: var(--c-accent); text-decoration: underline; }

.footer-bottom {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 12px 24px;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  margin-top: 40px;
  padding-top: 24px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--c-border);
  color: var(--c-text-faint);
  font-size: 14px;
}
.footer-note { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 8px; max-width: 52ch; }
.footer-note svg { flex: 0 0 auto; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--c-warn); }

/* ==========================================================================
   11. 断点
   ========================================================================== */
@media (min-width: 560px) {
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (min-width: 720px) {
  .cards { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
}
@media (min-width: 860px) {
  .hero-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.05fr .95fr; }
  .plans { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); }
  .subscribe-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1.6fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
}
@media (max-width: 899px) {
  .nav { display: none; }        /* 单页内容滚动可达，移动端优先保住主题切换与换行安全 */
}
@media (max-width: 539px) {
  .header-cta { display: none; }
}

/* ==========================================================================
   12. 动效降级
   ========================================================================== */
.reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
.js-reveal .reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); }
.js-reveal .reveal.is-visible {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: none;
  transition: opacity .5s ease, transform .5s cubic-bezier(.22, .61, .36, 1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html { scroll-behavior: auto; }

  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: .01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: .01ms !important;
  }
  .js-reveal .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
  .route-comet { display: none; }
  .card:hover { transform: none; }
  .btn-primary:active { transform: none; }
}
</style>
</head>

      </svg>
      <span class="brand-text">

        <span class="brand-sub">NightRide</span>
      </span>

(function () {
  'use strict';

  var root = document.documentElement;

  /* ======================================================================
     主题：system / light / dark
     ====================================================================== */
  var STORAGE_KEY = 'nightride-theme';
  var radios = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('input[name="theme"]'));
  var themeColorMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');
  var darkQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

  function store(pref) {
    try { localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, pref); } catch (e) { /* 受限源，忽略 */ }
  }

  function applyTheme(pref) {
    root.setAttribute('data-theme', pref);
    radios.forEach(function (radio) { radio.checked = (radio.value === pref); });

    var isDark = pref === 'dark' || (pref === 'system' && darkQuery.matches);
    if (themeColorMeta) {
      themeColorMeta.setAttribute('content', isDark ? '#0A0E13' : '#F6F8FA');
    }
  }

  var stored = 'system';
  try {
    var saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') { stored = saved; }
  } catch (e) { /* 受限源，忽略 */ }
  applyTheme(stored);

  radios.forEach(function (radio) {
    radio.addEventListener('change', function () {
      if (!radio.checked) { return; }
      applyTheme(radio.value);
      store(radio.value);
    });
  });

  /* 跟随系统时，系统主题变化要同步 theme-color */
  var onSystemChange = function () {
    if (root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'system') { applyTheme('system'); }
  };
  if (typeof darkQuery.addEventListener === 'function') {
    darkQuery.addEventListener('change', onSystemChange);
  } else if (typeof darkQuery.addListener === 'function') {
    darkQuery.addListener(onSystemChange);   // 旧版 Safari
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     滚动入场：仅在 JS 可用且未要求降低动效时启用
     ====================================================================== */
  var reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
  var revealables = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.reveal'));

  function showAll() {
    revealables.forEach(function (el) { el.classList.add('is-visible'); });
  }

  if (revealables.length && !reduceMotion.matches && 'IntersectionObserver' in window) {
    root.classList.add('js-reveal');
    var observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          entry.target.classList.add('is-visible');
          observer.unobserve(entry.target);
        }
      });
    }, { rootMargin: '0px 0px -8% 0px', threshold: 0.08 });
    revealables.forEach(function (el) { observer.observe(el); });

    /* 兜底：脚本异常或元素始终不可见时，2.5s 后强制显示 */
    window.setTimeout(function () {
      revealables.forEach(function (el) {
        var box = el.getBoundingClientRect();
        if (box.top < window.innerHeight && !el.classList.contains('is-visible')) {
          el.classList.add('is-visible');
        }
      });
    }, 2500);
  } else {
    root.classList.remove('js-reveal');
    showAll();
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     订阅表单：就近错误提示
     ====================================================================== */
  var form = document.getElementById('subscribe-form');

  if (form) {
    var status = document.getElementById('form-status');
    var EMAIL_RE = /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}$/;

    var rules = {
      email: function (el) {
        var value = el.value.trim();
        if (!value) { return '请填写邮箱地址，我们才知道往哪儿发。'; }
        if (!EMAIL_RE.test(value)) { return '这个邮箱看着不完整 —— 检查一下 @ 和后面的域名。'; }
        return '';
      },
      frequency: function (el) {
        return el.value ? '' : '选一个大致频次，方便决定周报推几条路线。';
      },
      consent: function (el) {
        return el.checked ? '' : '需要先勾选同意，我们才能给你发邮件。';
      }
    };

    var fields = Array.prototype.slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('[data-field]')).map(function (wrap) {
      var name = wrap.getAttribute('data-field');
      return {
        wrap: wrap,
        name: name,
        el: form.elements[name],
        error: document.getElementById(name + '-error'),
        rule: rules[name],
        touched: false
      };
    });

    function setError(field, message) {
      field.wrap.classList.add('has-error');
      field.error.querySelector('[data-error-text]').textContent = message;
      field.error.hidden = false;
      field.el.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
    }

    function clearError(field) {
      field.wrap.classList.remove('has-error');
      field.error.hidden = true;
      field.el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    }

    function validate(field) {
      var message = field.rule(field.el);
      if (message) { setError(field, message); return false; }
      clearError(field);
      return true;
    }

    fields.forEach(function (field) {
      /* 失焦：有内容才提示，避免空着扫一遍就被红字追着跑 */
      field.el.addEventListener('blur', function () {
        if (field.el.type === 'checkbox') { return; }
        if (!field.el.value.trim()) { clearError(field); return; }
        field.touched = true;
        validate(field);
      });

      /* 改动：已经出过错就实时纠正 */
      var liveEvent = (field.el.type === 'checkbox' || field.el.tagName === 'SELECT') ? 'change' : 'input';
      field.el.addEventListener(liveEvent, function () {
        if (field.el.type === 'checkbox' && !field.touched) {
          field.touched = true;
          validate(field);
          return;
        }
        if (field.touched) { validate(field); }
      });

      /* 从错误态回到正常时，清掉 touched，让实时校验停下来 */
      field.el.addEventListener('input', function () {
        if (field.touched && field.rule(field.el) === '') { field.touched = false; }
      });
    });

    form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
      event.preventDefault();
      if (status) { status.hidden = true; }

      var firstInvalid = null;
      fields.forEach(function (field) {
        field.touched = true;
        if (!validate(field) && !firstInvalid) { firstInvalid = field.el; }
      });

      if (firstInvalid) {
        firstInvalid.focus();
        return;
      }

      /* 无后端：这里模拟成功，并把表单复位 */
      if (status) { status.hidden = false; }
      form.reset();
      fields.forEach(function (field) { field.touched = false; clearError(field); });
    });
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     页脚年份
     ====================================================================== */
  var year = document.getElementById('year');
  if (year) { year.textContent = String(new Date().getFullYear()); }
})();
